findings.description: Finalizer checks builder identity on current8+12 records but not their all_passed or per-row flags. It can write a bounded-pass manifest even if a bound current-source regression reports a failed case. It also states prior59 passes without checking the actual21+38 rows and55a7 source bindings.
findings.requested_fix: Require all_passed and every per-case passed flag with exact reported/current source identities; derive/check21+38 and8+12 from schemas before making revision-scoped claim.

findings.description: Only status and empty findings are required, so a stale independent closure review can be carried into a supposedly current final manifest. Source/render/script identities are available in the protection record and forthcoming reconciliation schema.
findings.requested_fix: Require protection bound_sources equal final review source map and reviewed_scripts rehash match. Bind reconciliation review to current render/visual/reconciliation records using its actual saved schema.

positive_observations: The finalizer checks actual current document review source identities, three distinct publication labels, actual published PDF bytes, visual-review digest equality, complete page lists and successful actual package-part equivalence.
It explicitly distinguishes historical59case revision from the newer8check/12case revision; no blanket current59claim is made.
The explicit optimization guard keeps assertions enabled; manifest scope correctly excludes scientific recomputation and implementation-refinement proofs.
scope: Read-only finalization driver and actual report-schema assessment. Real finalizer and publication were not executed. No document or scientific source edits.
limits: Parent will patch gates before execution; final followup review must bind the final script identity.
Manifest should include the final independent finalization driver review identity, without that review hashing the manifest to avoid a cycle.
